Direct Binary Upload to S3 (Presigned PUT URL)
Media Pipeline & Edge CDN Delivery Architecture
S3 ObjectCreated → Transcoder Worker Fleet generates 150x150, 600x600, 1080x1080 WebP variants + NSFW safety scan.
Global CDN (Cloudflare/CloudFront) caches images at 300+ Edge PoPs worldwide, achieving > 99% cache hit and < 50ms photo TTFB.
Regular Users (< 5K followers): Fan-Out on Write (Push).
Saves 99.9% of write amplification on viral accounts!
3. Direct PUT raw photo binary to S3
7. Normal user: ZADD to follower Redis timelines
9. K-way merge: user timeline + followed celebrity posts
10. Stream WebP images from CDN edge PoP (< 50ms TTFB)
1. Direct-to-S3 uploads decouple high-bandwidth media streams from application servers, avoiding gateway socket exhaustion.
2. Hybrid Fan-Out achieves sub-150ms P99 feed response times for 100M DAU while completely shielding timeline caches from celebrity follower write spikes.
Core Principles: Presigned Direct Uploads + Asynchronous WebP Transcoding + Hybrid Fan-Out Timeline Caches + Global Edge CDN
